_readme: Owner-supplied facts that fill the '[...]' blanks inside the legal texts. Keys are the EXACT blank strings as they appear in data/legal/legal-texts.json. Leave a value empty ('') until the owner/attorney confirms it — pages then render the blank as a clearly marked draft field. Never invent values. Values are substituted at render time only; legal-texts.json (generated from LEGAL_COMPLIANCE.md) stays the single source of truth for the wording.
